title: picea abies f. erythrocarpa
intro: Picea abies f. erythrocarpa, commonly known as the Norwegian red spruce, is a subspecies of the Eurasian spruce tree. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as bronchitis and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant and anti-spasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for coughs, colds, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Picea abies f. erythrocarpa include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
